derivations.revenue: 426,517m INR (Rs 42,651.7 crore) as reported for FY2024. Cross-checked against two independently published S&P ratios for the same year: PS 1.56 x market cap 664,088 = 425,697, and EV 3,064,358 / (EV/Sales 7.20) = 425,605. Both within 0.25%.
derivations.net_income: -312,387m INR, from published FY2024 earnings yield -47.04% x market cap 664,088. Independently corroborated by the retained earnings movement: -2,339,687 - (-2,031,621) = -308,066.
derivations.ebit: DELIBERATELY OMITTED. Operating income is not published as a standardised line item in the source used, and deriving it from EBITDA would require a depreciation and amortisation figure that is also unavailable. Rather than invent it, the file omits it: the engine reports confidence PARTIAL, lists x3 in omitted_components, and still returns DISTRESS from the four remaining terms. Covered by test_altman_zscore.py::test_vodafone_idea_partial_but_decisive.
derivations.market_value_equity: 664,088m INR, published FY2024 market capitalisation. Not used by Z'' (whose X4 takes BOOK equity) - included so the misapplication of the 1968 model to a non-manufacturer can be demonstrated, as it is in the tests.
